text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Summer camp begins! I learned in class that a lot of racers make huge leaps and bounds in improvement during summer!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm going to do my best preparing for the Sprinters Stakes too! And, of course, I'll be keeping a close eye on Sky as well.
